exposure: mother's return to duty after childbirth
outcome: timing of mothers' return to duty
prevalence of breastfeeding initiation within an hour
cohort: The study participants were 550 mothers residing in rural areas of Ramanagara district, Karnataka, India, each having at least one child less than two years old.
finding: The study concluded that the postnatal care practices for mothers and neonates in the studied rural area were not harmful, attributing this to effective healthcare staff and community participation.
cross-section timing: Data was collected on postnatal care practices from mothers whose children were less than two years old at the time of the interview.
birth_weight: 2741 ± 321 Grams for male babies and 2695 ± 344 Grams for female babies.
